name: Safety Instrumented System
description: Independent safety layer that detects hazardous conditions and drives the process to a safe state; ESD and fire & gas are core SIFs on offshore and onshore facilities.

specifications.basis: ISA-84 Standards page: defines SIS lifecycle framework and performance targets based on Safety Integrity Levels (SIL)

specifications.value: ANSI/ISA-61511-3-2018 / IEC 61511-3:2016 - guidance for determination of required SIL; covers tolerable risk and methodologies
ISA-TR84.00.02-2022: SIL Verification of Safety Instrumented Functions - random and systematic failures, spurious trip rates, failure probabilities
ISA-TR84.00.08-2017: Guidance for Application of Wireless Sensor Technology to Non-SIS Independent Protection Layers
design, installation, operation, maintenance, decommissioning; plus ISA-TR84.00.09-2024 cybersecurity related to the safety lifecycle
